says: In next/, handle replays only the key presses still in the run's line, so a click on a tile or a tezgah frame waiting ahead of them is not seen, and C-b x judged against the old focus or tile count decides wrongly whether it asks y/n, leaving the y to the tile and the question open.
proof: A scratch scenario in Tezgah.laws.test.ts (two tiles, focus on tile 1 that tezgah did not start, line = focus click on tile 2 then ctrl+b x y, nothing read): handle answered ctrl+b take, x take, y leave, and after the run read the line its prefix._tag was asking; read one press at a time, y closes tile 2.
cost: A person who clicks a tile tezgah started and at once types C-b x y gets a y in the tile and a close question nobody answers; the 1043 law cannot see it because its line only holds presses.
